The '''Rothkar family''' was a well-respected family in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the family's [[Unidentified Nikto (Rothkar family)|Nikto enslaved worker]] escaped after harsh mistreatment, and in revenge the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] began [[Death/Legends|murdering]] the Rothkar family one member at a time.
